title: Newlight Raises $9M to Test Hydrogen Injection for Cargo Ships
dek: The startup says it has completed an 8,500-nautical-mile voyage from Singapore to Ghana as it develops hydrogen fuel-injection technology for maritime efficiency.
socialCaption: Cargo-shipping startup Newlight has raised $9M and completed an 8,500-nautical-mile Singapore-to-Ghana test run for its hydrogen fuel-injection technology. The next test is commercial: repeatable efficiency gains on working fleets.
